title: Meeting of scientists with J. Allen Hynek about Owens
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Meeting of scientists with J. Allen Hynek about Owens, about 1977-1978 at Berkeley area, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
